t.E405.agn: In 2018 EFSA set an acceptable daily intake (ADI) of 55 mg/kg body weight, based on the maximum 45% propane-1,2-diol content of the additive and that substance's ADI of 25 mg/kg. No adverse effects were reported in animal studies; no concern for genotoxic or carcinogenic effects was identified.
t.E405.body: In the gut it partly dissociates into propane-1,2-diol (propylene glycol) and alginic acid; about a quarter of the propane-1,2-diol portion passes into the body.
t.E405.found.2: Confectionery, chewing gum and bakery fillings
t.E405.prod: Obtained by the chemical reaction of alginic acid with propylene oxide.
t.E405.regx.0: Re-evaluated; ADI 55 mg/kg body weight per day.
t.E405.summary: A thickener produced from alginic acid. It preserves beer foam and thickens salad dressings.
t.E405.what: Thickens and keeps foam and mixtures stable.
